title: Manhunt but you get random effects
description: This is Minecraft Manhunt however, when the manhunt commences every 5 minutes the hunters and runners get a random effect for 30 seconds, it could be anything from strength, speed, or poison. Good Luck and have fun.
body:
This is Minecraft Manhunt, just like how famous creators like Dream, Daquavious, and Babluu do it, however thers a twist, every 5 minutes you get a random effect-could be good could be bad. 

Commands:
/hunt <hunter> <runner>
/start --starts the potion giver command
